Before you download, check

  • The photo is Gracelyn's real food and matches the words (no stock food, no AI images).
  • No prices. Say "enquire" or "order now" instead.
  • The phone number reads 0432 207 931.
  • Australian spelling (colour, favourite, organise) and no long dashes.
  • Every word fits comfortably. If anything looks squashed, shorten it.
  • Only real quotes and real customer words. Never invent a testimonial.
